    (09/02/2026). The energy price index rose 8.8% in August, led by natural gas (+10.1%) and crude oil (+5.7%). Food prices increased 1.4%, while beverage and raw material prices rose 2.0% and 2.2%, respectively. Fertilizer prices eased 1.9%. Metal prices increased 4.0%, while precious metals surged 8.8%.
